evidence: The homepage visibly frames the practice as helping emerging work become usable systems and gives direct paths to Technical Operations, Harry J. Epstein Company, FairRentNYC, CallNYC, and the resume.

The About page, reachable directly from the homepage navigation, plainly names the recursive method: observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document enough for others to continue.

The About page reconstructs complete systems loops for three linked projects. Harry J. Epstein connects customer and operational relationships to a unified storefront, real customer and team use, analytics-guided iteration, reusable patterns, and clearer workflows. FairRentNYC connects testimony, public sources, open questions, and civic actors to campaign sites, public participation, running minutes, source maps, question logs, and action trackers. Sunday Dinner and 196 connects hospitality and recurring participation to invitations, hosting and residency workflows, repeated use, documentation, and handoffs.

Additional linked examples reinforce continuity without collapsing unlike projects: WOWList turns organizers’ existing community language into followable keyword communities and distribution workflows; Knowledge Wiki Graphs turns source, evidence, custody, and semantic relationships into human-reviewed projections and tested handoffs; CallNYC turns administrative data into resident-recognizable issue pathways while retaining an explicit archived and unofficial status.
The Technical Operations page translates the same method into inspectable decision-and-action records, artifacts, usable outcomes, and handoffs rather than presenting a disconnected tool list.

The public resume independently supports the role narrative through product lifecycle, cross-functional delivery, responsible public technology, and project-specific implementation evidence. Its AI Evals entry is explicitly professional development, and it makes no claim of instructor affiliation, disciplinary invention, peer-reviewed research, production deployment, or current Max/Jitter proficiency.

The Open House projection stays within the bounded source note: the About page describes Jamie as initiating the ten-day experiment while crediting participant use, communal decision-making, and many-perspective documentation; its source boundary expressly rejects sole authorship of collective activity, permission to republish participant details or images, complete attendance, and long-term outcome claims.
safety_findings: No raw Open House article text, photographs, participant roster, or protected educational record is exposed.
Collective participation is not converted into sole-authorship or sole-causation claims; project pages repeatedly preserve collaborator credit and scope boundaries.

Knowledge Wiki Graphs and Source-Backed Team Memory are clearly labeled early research and an operating method in development, not finished SaaS, client adoption, automated trust, or a production deployment.
Historical CallNYC evidence is prominently bounded as archived, independent, unofficial, and unsuitable as current constituent-service guidance.

The candidate explicitly warns that recurring analytical steps do not establish structural equivalence among different projects and that historical implementation does not establish present technical proficiency.
No material public-safety or evidence gap was observed under PR-016.
recommendation: Pass at 4. The candidate satisfies every PR-016 blocking criterion: it names the recursive method within one click of the homepage, demonstrates the full sequence through at least three linked and bounded projects, connects social structure and information architecture to collective use, learning, and durable handoffs, and maintains disciplined coursework, authorship, deployment, and source-projection boundaries.
